paved entry inside the gate, gate width from hero-2560 (14.3 m between the outer piers)

paving along the east wing under the Terminalia canopy (scenery_13); extent hidden on the Esri layer

dark paving with light squares west of the plaza to x ~-30..-36 (aerial_campus homography; Esri patch x -24..-15, y 16..20)
light plaza x +/-12.5 for y 20..29.8 and x +/-14.7 for y 13..20 on the Esri layer (south of y 13 hidden by the roof lean, assumed to run to the building); dot grid from aerial_campus

planting bed with ground cover, moss and set stones round the trunk (lanshu-1600: ground cover from the root flare to the right edge of the picture, while the boulders to the east stand on paving); centred on the trunk position calibrated on lanshu-1600, kept clear of the side-plaza steps at y 20.5; outline estimated

steps.basis: four red granite risers either side of the rock plinth (jiaoxuelou-1600, aerial_campus); tread assumed

steps down from the side plaza in the foreground of lanshu-1600 (grey stone, three risers); light strip along the side plaza's north edge on aerial_campus; full-length flight assumed. Back-projected with the calibrated lanshu-1600 camera the top nosing lies at y 19.8-20.2 (if the plaza is at z 0.60) and the treads look 0.2-0.3 m deep; at this grazing angle 0.1 m of level error moves the edge by about 0.7 m, so the edge is left at y 20.5 and listed for checking

hedges.basis: low clipped hedge in a planter along the east colonnade (scenery_13, aerial_campus)
hedge along the west colonnade (jiaoxuelou-1600, aerial_campus)

taihu.basis: dark granite plinth with a lawn bed, its north face level with the foot of the steps and its east end against them (jiaoxuelou-1600); width 7.5 m and a 0.25 m westward offset from the hero-2560 camera fit (corner residuals of the earlier 9.6 m plinth: -30 / +19 px at 0.043 m/px); depth from the rock's footprint on the Esri layer. OSM puts the artwork 4-5 m further south (y 20.3..24.5). Checked on jiaoxuelou-1600 with its calibrated camera: with the plinth 7.5 m long at this position its height comes out 0.78 +/- 0.05 m (model 0.75).
taihu.inscription_basis: text read on jiaoxuelou-1600 (running-script calligraphy, 8 characters, signed); typeface substituted. Panels placed with the calibrated jiaoxuelou-1600 camera: the inscription on the raised middle slab (x -1.5..1.4), the alumni donation (2012) on the west end slab (x -3.95..-3.3), modelled blank; the phase-1 model had them the other way round.
taihu.rock_basis: carved from its outlines on two calibrated photographs (jiaoxuelou-1600: camera fitted on 12 line features of the portal, tower and plinth, 1.6 px rms; hero-2560), twin/evidence/calibration/taihu-silhouettes.json and tools/taihu_carve.py: outline seen from the north within about 0.05 m (overlap with the traced outlines 0.93 and 0.86), twelve photographed holes and caves drilled where they are on jiaoxuelou-1600; depth (about 3 m) is an inflation of the outline about the middle of the bed, not observed; the division into rounded masses (seeded Voronoi cells with crevices), lumps, creases and pits are procedural and not the real ones. About 7.7 x 3.1 x 3.1 m above the lawn.

gate_north.name: 北门（海南中學牌坊）
gate_north.frame: Twin frame. x across the gate (campus east +), y along the axis (+ towards the street), z up from the road (0).

evidence.hero: assets/images/web/hero-2560.jpg: frontal view from the street. Camera recovered from the scene: level (horizon row 1075 from the converging kerbs), principal column 1280, f ~2036 px, eye 1.52 m, about 13.8 m in front of the gate face. Gate-plane scale 6.78 mm/px; elements in front of the gate (lions) at ~12.5 m: 6.14 mm/px.
evidence.osm: campus boundary vertex on the axis at y 105.7 (OpenStreetMap via Overture 2026-11-18.0); the gate is placed with its centre plane at y = 106.0 on the axis. The 0.4 m parallax between the gate centre and the Teaching Block 1 portal on hero-2560 is within the uncertainty.
evidence.landscape_intro: assets/images/campus/landscape_intro.jpg: same gate, slightly wider, confirms bay rhythm, lions, walls

gate_north.basis: All heights and widths measured on hero-2560 in the gate plane (focal-length independent ratios checked against ground-contact back-projection); depth (front-back) of piers and roofs is not visible and is estimated.

central_bay.text_note: displayed left to right as 學中南海, read right to left as 海南中學

central.basis: eave board bottom row 200 px (7.45 m), ridge row 76 px (8.3 m), eave span 10.8 m in the photo reduced for the eaves' projection towards the camera

side.basis: eave row 476 px (5.6 m), ridge row 370 px (6.3 m), outer eave about 1.3 m beyond the outer pier

lions.basis: four white stone lions on square pedestals in front of the piers (hero-2560: pedestal top 0.94 m, lion top 2.04 m); carving simplified

walls.basis: line of the OSM campus boundary; white rendered wall with green glazed-tile coping and a notice board east of the gate (left edge of hero-2560); height estimated

gatehouse.basis: white building with a green-tiled hip roof west of the gate (right edge of hero-2560, camera facing south); footprint estimated

booth.basis: guard booth and turnstiles in the west side opening (right-hand opening seen from the street, hero-2560)

open_questions: Gate depth (piers and roofs front to back) and the south face are not photographed; the south face repeats the north face with a blank plaque (invented).
Exact position along the axis rests on the OSM boundary (y 105.7); the photo puts the camera 13.8 m in front of the gate, which is consistent but not independent.

central.basis: 3 bays of 7.09 m on the axis (window centres 0, +/-7.09); window width 0.656 bay, height 0.335 storey-pitch (hero-2560); visible front between the granite towers 2.84 bays = 20.1 m; walls behind the towers +/-12.1 from the Esri eave width 26.6 m minus 1.2 m overhang

towers.basis: tower = 0.91 central bay (campus_yihao 147/159 px; aerial 120/135 px); inner face 0.59 m inside the outer central bays (hero-2560); outer face +/-16.5 meets the wing roofs (Esri +/-16.3). pavilions.basis: end roofs 11.0-11.5 m wide x 18 m deep incl. eaves, ridge running front-back (Esri, aerial); overall roof length 116 m eave to eave; narrow front with one column of small windows (aerial)

portal.basis: hero-2560: portal 157 px wide at 17.8 px/m (5.6 m in front of the facade) = 8.8 m, opening 5.0 m; terrace/top at 8.0 m; lintel and 1923 from jiaoxuelou-1600 proportions

canopy.basis: hero-2560: eave corners at rows 893 (10.6 m), ridge row 852 (about 13 m), eaves 218 px = 12.1 m

side.basis: hero-2560: red shed roofs rows 943-960 (8.2 -> 7.0 m) reaching the towers; side portal cap rows 993-1000 (4.9-5.1 m), opening 43 px = 2.4 m wide, head at 4.0 m

through_hall.basis: the courtyard and the next building are visible through the portal on jiaoxuelou-1600: open ground-floor passage

links.basis: two white flat-roofed links on the Esri layer, symmetric about the axis after lean correction; OSM ways 1165596684/1165596685 run from the rear of Teaching Block 1 to the front of Teaching Block 2 (y -44); their facades are unknown

rear.basis: No photograph of the rear (courtyard) facades was available; a corridor facade with windows is assumed.

central.basis: aerial / campus_yihao: hipped, upturned corners, white fascia, ridges and curled ridge ends

open_questions: Absolute scale of the facade rests on the Esri eave width (26.6 m) and the aerial reading that the central eave corners sit over the tower centre lines; a single taped dimension (e.g. a central bay or the portal) would fix every storey height.
Long axis rotated +0.7 deg (OSM outline) to +1.2 deg (roof eaves) against the axis-road bearing; not applied.
OSM puts the front wall 1.3-2.4 m further north than the lean-corrected Esri reading used for the origin.
Top-storey windows read taller (2.35 m) than the others (1.93 m) on hero-2560; modelled, not confirmed elsewhere.
Rear facades, link facades and the courtyard are not photographed.

terminalia_hero.name: 百年榄仁树
terminalia_hero.basis: Calibrated on lanshu-1600 (twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.report.json, camera fitted on 37 facade lines, 0.70 px rms). Trunk on the ray through its image centre at 12.0 m from the camera, i.e. (38.9, 17.7): the root flare meets the ground at z 0.6-0.75, the trunk is 1.0 m thick and the low limb tapers as on the photograph only at this distance; the phase-1 position (31, 13, from an aerial blob) put the trunk 8-9 m too far west. Uncertainty about +/- 1.5 m along the view direction, +/- 0.2 m across. Visible limbs (low limb resting on the tall boulder and turning up into a stem, the two limbs rising from it, the leader and two crotch limbs) are back-projected from pixel traces with stated plane assumptions (twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json, tools/lanren_backproject.py); limbs hidden from this view and everything above the frame are estimated to fill the mapped crown.

envelope.basis: crown outline: the sunlit Terminalia crown on the Esri layer of the east side plaza (about x 26-60, y 1-32, centre near 43, 17.5), clipped at the wing facade, at y 32 and where it meets the crown of east_big; heights estimated (no view shows the top of the crown)

limbs.basis: trunk centreline and width (104-120 px) on lanshu-1600, at the calibrated trunk position; crotch at z 4.2-5.0 (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)

the long low limb: leaves the crotch at z 4.0, runs east towards the camera in an S-curve (low points z 2.3 at image x 775 and z 2.15 at x 430-500) to rest on the tall boulder at z 2.3, 8.3 m from the trunk, then turns up into a stem rising from the boulder top (traced to z 4.6 at the top of the frame; above that estimated).  Plane: vertical, through the trunk and the boulder centre; stem in the plane facing the camera through the boulder.  Widths 90 px near the trunk to 50 px at the boulder; the stem is 75 px (0.36 m), thicker than the limb just before the boulder, as on the photograph. (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)
short hanging stub under the low limb (image x 400-470, y 740-815), in the limb plane (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)

limb rising from the low limb at its first fork (image 905, 605) and curving up to the top of the frame; assumed to grow south (towards the wing) in a vertical plane, because the photograph does not show its depth (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)

limb leaving the low limb at its second fork (image 830, 650) and rising to the left edge of the frame, crossing behind the top of the boulder stem; assumed to run east-south-east (azimuth -25 deg), slightly behind the low limb (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)

upright limb from the crotch (image x 1300-1380), leaning north-west in the plane facing the camera; above the frame (z 7.3) estimated (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)
heavy limb from the crotch to the upper right corner; assumed north-west (azimuth 125 deg) (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)
thinner limb rising up-left from the crotch (image x 1020-1150); assumed south-south-east (back-projected from lanshu-1600; see twin/evidence/calibration/lanshu-1600.tree.json)
